correctness.rationale: Basis e_k=z^k/h_k, with h_k squared equal to a gamma ratio, gives exact orthogonal-column coefficients for every m,n and alpha>-1. The gcd>1 subsequences yield the exact Calkin modulus spectrum; when gcd=1, the two-term gamma expansion yields positive c/q+O(q^-2), and counting inversion proves Ns_N→c and the sharp p>1 cutoff. A standalone checker passed 6966 finite assertions, supplementing rather than replacing the infinite proof.

Semantic database and accessible historical-claim comparisons reveal no statement implying the full gcd criterion plus weighted Bergman singular-value coefficient; inaccessible more general older theorems remain a specific risk, so this is a best-knowledge finding rather than absolute priority certification.

value.rationale: Determines a naturally complete arithmetic phase diagram for all nontrivial monomial composition pairs, contrasting noncompact individual products with cancellation of their difference.
